guests.title: Guest chats in the inbox
guests.description: Escalated: guest chats show only once handed to a person. Signed in: only signed-in visitors' chats show, in the list, its counts and the unread badge (staff alerts still go out).

pauseNeeds.title: Pausing the AI needs
pauseNeeds.description: Manage: the ticket permission inbox.manage. Reply: inbox.reply.

aiTagging.title: The AI tags conversations
aiTagging.description: When a chat is handed to a person, and when it is resolved, the AI picks its topic, tags and priority from your lists (Settings → Inbox), never others, and leaves what your staff already set. Needs AI replies.

autoAssign.title: Assign automatically
autoAssign.description: First replier: an unassigned chat goes to the first member of staff who replies. Round robin: to online member who got one longest ago. Least busy: to member with fewest open chats.

maxChats.title: Default max concurrent chats per person

queuePosition.title: Show visitors their place in line

notesMode.title: Internal notes
notesMode.description: Timeline: notes between messages. Single: one editable note per chat.

summaryInstructions.title: Summary instructions
summaryInstructions.default: Summarize this support chat for a member of the team in at most five short lines: what the visitor wants, what was answered, and what is still open.
summaryInstructions.description: What the summary says, how long it is and its language, in your words.

adminUrl.title: Conversation page address in your admin
adminUrl.description: The page of your admin where staff open a conversation (e.g. https://admin.example.com/inbox?conversation={conversationId}).

frequency.title: New message alerts
frequency.description: First unanswered: once until staff reply or open the chat. Every message: on every visitor message.

staffPermission.title: Also alert Accounts staff who can

contextPanel.title: Show visitor context panel
contextPanel.description: Shows visitor details, past conversations and store history beside the chat.
